title: 💠 From the Tanker War to Underwater Competition;
text:
💠 From the Tanker War to Underwater Competition;  "
"Naval Confrontation Enters a New Phase"

"🔹 Hojjat al-Islam wal-Muslimin Haji-Sadeghi, the Supreme Leader’s representative in the IRGC, visited missile and naval capabilities as part of his continued trip to southern Iran."

"🔹 This segment covers the experience of the Tanker War in the 1980s and the emergence of an asymmetric warfare approach, recent attacks on US military targets—including an early warning system at Al Udeid Air Base—and the seizure of a US unmanned underwater vehicle near the Strait of Hormuz in Shahrivar 1405 (August–September 2026)."

"📍 Excerpt from *In the Fortress of Faith*, a special program by the IRGC television team."

"🌐 Watch the full episode on Telewebion:  "
